name: enterprise-cx-guardian-ai
description: Enterprise CX Guardian AI - Real-time Safety Navigation and Emergency Response Platform

scripts.dev:manager: concurrently -n "SERVER,MANAGER" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace manager"
scripts.dev:support: concurrently -n "SERVER,SUPPORT" -c "cyan,blue" "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace support"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace manager && npm run build --workspace support
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace server && cd ai-service && python -m pytest
